"""Seal an acquired 20 Hz camera frame map and media for saved-source audit.

Call only after Native capture exits. The caller supplies original camera frame
readbacks and media files; this module never fabricates camera observations.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from delivery_audit import CAMERAS, CASE_PREFIX
from speed_boundary import EXPECTED_FRAMES, measure


def _bind(attempt: Path, path: Path) -> dict:
    if (not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink() or
            not path.resolve().is_relative_to(attempt.resolve())):
        raise ValueError("camera source missing or outside attempt")
    return {"path": str(path.relative_to(attempt)),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}


def finalize_capture(attempt: Path, case_id: str, camera_frames: list[dict],
                     camera_media: dict[str, Path], *,
                     site_source: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    """Write source index once, only after all original sources pass joins."""
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    if case_id not in {CASE_PREFIX + suffix for suffix in ("below", "equal", "above")}:
        raise ValueError("unknown exact case")
    index_path, map_path = attempt / "capture-index.json", attempt / "frame-map.json"
    if index_path.exists() or map_path.exists():
        raise ValueError("capture finalization already exists")
    speed = measure(attempt, case_id)
    motion_path = attempt / "native-motion-receipt.json"
    motion = json.loads(motion_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if (motion.get("case_id") != case_id or
            motion.get("native_run_id") != speed["native_run_id"] or
            motion.get("speed_source_sha256") != speed["source_sha256"] or
            motion.get("diagnostic_fixture") != speed["diagnostic_fixture"]):
        raise ValueError("Native motion and original speed differ")
    original_camera_hash = motion.get("camera_frame_readback_sha256")
    if original_camera_hash is not None:
        readback_path = attempt / "camera-frame-readback.json"
        readback_raw = readback_path.read_bytes()
        if hashlib.sha256(readback_raw).hexdigest() != original_camera_hash:
            raise ValueError("original camera readback hash differs")
        readback = json.loads(readback_raw)
        if (readback.get("case_id") != case_id or
                readback.get("native_run_id") != speed["native_run_id"] or
                readback.get("frames") != camera_frames):
            raise ValueError("original camera readback and finalization differ")
    if (not isinstance(camera_frames, list) or len(camera_frames) != EXPECTED_FRAMES or
            not isinstance(camera_media, dict) or set(camera_media) != set(CAMERAS)):
        raise ValueError("four camera sources and 900 original frames required")
    descriptor = json.loads((attempt / "speed-source.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    origin = descriptor["source_frame_origin"]
    for i, row in enumerate(camera_frames):
        if (not isinstance(row, dict) or row.get("frame") != origin + i or
                row.get("camera_frames") != {camera: origin + i for camera in CAMERAS}):
            raise ValueError("original camera frame join differs")
    bindings = {camera: _bind(attempt, Path(camera_media[camera])) for camera in CAMERAS}
    frame_map = {"case_id": case_id, "native_run_id": speed["native_run_id"],
                 "frames": camera_frames}
    raw = (json.dumps(frame_map, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode()
    index = {"format": "c10301-capture-index-v1", "case_id": case_id,
             "frame_count": EXPECTED_FRAMES,
             "diagnostic_fixture": speed["diagnostic_fixture"],
             "native_motion": _bind(attempt, motion_path),
             "frame_map": {"path": map_path.name,
                           "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()},
             "cameras": bindings}
    if site_source is not None:
        source_binding = _bind(attempt, Path(site_source))
        site = json.loads(Path(site_source).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if (site.get('case_id') != case_id or
                site.get('diagnostic_fixture') != speed['diagnostic_fixture'] or
                site.get('format') != 'c10301-native-site-v1'):
            raise ValueError('original Native site source differs')
        index['native_site'] = source_binding
    map_path.write_bytes(raw)
    index_path.write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
                          encoding="utf-8")
    return index

"""Independent saved-source integrity audit for exact 80 mph attempts.

This is a preparation check. Hashes and frame joins do not establish actual
pixels, public-way status, physical completion, or a legal speed judgment.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import math
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from speed_boundary import EXPECTED_FRAMES, measure

CASE_PREFIX = "testing__C10301__NRS-484B-600-1e__motor_vehicle_driver__"
CAMERAS = ("front", "front_left", "front_right", "rear")


def _read(path: Path) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError("source document is not an object")
    return value


def _sealed(attempt: Path, entry: dict, label: str) -> tuple[Path, str]:
    if not isinstance(entry, dict) or set(entry) != {"path", "sha256"}:
        raise ValueError(f"{label} binding incomplete")
    name, digest = entry["path"], entry["sha256"]
    if (not isinstance(name, str) or not name or Path(name).is_absolute() or
            ".." in Path(name).parts or not isinstance(digest, str) or
            len(digest) != 64):
        raise ValueError(f"{label} binding invalid")
    path = attempt / name
    if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(attempt.resolve()):
        raise ValueError(f"{label} source missing or escapes attempt")
    observed = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if observed != digest:
        raise ValueError(f"{label} source hash differs")
    return path, observed


def audit_integrity(attempt: Path, case_id: str, *, allow_diagnostic: bool = False) -> dict:
    """Require original trace, frame map, four media files, and receipt joins."""
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    if case_id not in {CASE_PREFIX + suffix for suffix in ("below", "equal", "above")}:
        raise ValueError("unknown exact case")
    index = _read(attempt / "capture-index.json")
    if (index.get("format") != "c10301-capture-index-v1" or
            index.get("case_id") != case_id or
            index.get("frame_count") != EXPECTED_FRAMES or
            type(index.get("diagnostic_fixture")) is not bool):
        raise ValueError("capture index identity or frame count differs")
    if index["diagnostic_fixture"] and not allow_diagnostic:
        raise ValueError("diagnostic fixture cannot enter delivery audit")
    site_binding = index.get('native_site')
    site_hash = None
    if site_binding is not None:
        site_path, site_hash = _sealed(attempt, site_binding, 'Native site')
        site = _read(site_path)
        if (site.get('format') != 'c10301-native-site-v1' or
                site.get('case_id') != case_id or
                site.get('cell_id') != 'C10301' or
                site.get('actor') != 'motor_vehicle_driver' or
                site.get('layout') != 'alley' or
                site.get('control') != 'access_aisle' or
                site.get('maneuver') != 'travel' or
                site.get('diagnostic_fixture') != index['diagnostic_fixture']):
            raise ValueError('Native site and capture index differ')
    speed = measure(attempt, case_id)
    if speed["diagnostic_fixture"] != index["diagnostic_fixture"]:
        raise ValueError("speed and capture provenance differ")
    motion_path, motion_hash = _sealed(attempt, index.get("native_motion"), "Native motion")
    motion = _read(motion_path)
    if (motion.get("format") != "c10301-native-motion-v1" or
            motion.get("case_id") != case_id or
            motion.get("native_run_id") != speed["native_run_id"] or
            motion.get("speed_source_sha256") != speed["source_sha256"] or
            motion.get("diagnostic_fixture") != index["diagnostic_fixture"] or
            motion.get("sample_count") != EXPECTED_FRAMES or
            type(motion.get("travel_m")) not in (int, float) or
            not math.isfinite(motion["travel_m"]) or
            motion["travel_m"] < 100 or
            motion.get("physical_acceptance_claimed") is not False):
        raise ValueError("Native motion and capture index differ")
    map_path, map_hash = _sealed(attempt, index.get("frame_map"), "frame map")
    frame_map = _read(map_path)
    frames = frame_map.get("frames")
    if (frame_map.get("case_id") != case_id or
            frame_map.get("native_run_id") != speed["native_run_id"] or
            not isinstance(frames, list) or len(frames) != EXPECTED_FRAMES):
        raise ValueError("original frame map incomplete")
    origin = frames[0].get("frame") if isinstance(frames[0], dict) else None
    if type(origin) is not int or origin < 0:
        raise ValueError("original frame origin invalid")
    for i, row in enumerate(frames):
        if (not isinstance(row, dict) or row.get("frame") != origin + i or
                row.get("camera_frames") != {camera: origin + i for camera in CAMERAS}):
            raise ValueError("camera and original frame join differs")
    camera_readback_hash = motion.get("camera_frame_readback_sha256")
    if camera_readback_hash is None and not allow_diagnostic:
        raise ValueError("original camera readback required for delivery")
    if site_binding is None and not allow_diagnostic:
        raise ValueError('original Native site source required for delivery')
    route_readback_hash = motion.get('route_frame_readback_sha256')
    if route_readback_hash is None and not allow_diagnostic:
        raise ValueError('original route readback required for delivery')
    if route_readback_hash is not None:
        route_path = attempt / 'route-frame-readback.json'
        route_raw = route_path.read_bytes()
        if hashlib.sha256(route_raw).hexdigest() != route_readback_hash:
            raise ValueError('original route readback hash differs')
        route = json.loads(route_raw)
        route_frames = route.get('frames')
        if (route.get('case_id') != case_id or
                route.get('native_run_id') != speed['native_run_id'] or
                not isinstance(route_frames, list) or len(route_frames) != EXPECTED_FRAMES or
                [row.get('frame') for row in route_frames] != [row['frame'] for row in frames]):
            raise ValueError('original route and speed frame join differs')
        first_lane = (route_frames[0].get('road_id'), route_frames[0].get('lane_id'))
        prior_station = None
        for row in route_frames:
            station = row.get('route_s_m')
            offset = row.get('centerline_offset_m')
            if (row.get('source') != 'original_native_route_readback' or
                    (row.get('road_id'), row.get('lane_id')) != first_lane or
                    type(station) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(station) or
                    type(offset) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(offset) or
                    not 0 <= offset <= 2.0 or
                    (prior_station is not None and station < prior_station)):
                raise ValueError('original route readback left reviewed lane or centerline')
            prior_station = station
        if route_frames[-1]['route_s_m'] - route_frames[0]['route_s_m'] < 100:
            raise ValueError('original route station progress insufficient')
    if camera_readback_hash is not None:
        readback_path = attempt / "camera-frame-readback.json"
        raw = readback_path.read_bytes()
        if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != camera_readback_hash:
            raise ValueError("original camera readback hash differs")
        readback = json.loads(raw)
        if (readback.get("case_id") != case_id or
                readback.get("native_run_id") != speed["native_run_id"] or
                readback.get("frames") != frames):
            raise ValueError("original camera readback and frame map differ")
    cameras = index.get("cameras")
    if not isinstance(cameras, dict) or set(cameras) != set(CAMERAS):
        raise ValueError("four camera bindings required")
    camera_hashes = {}
    for camera in CAMERAS:
        _, camera_hashes[camera] = _sealed(attempt, cameras[camera], camera)
    return {"format": "c10301-source-integrity-v1", "case_id": case_id,
            "native_run_id": speed["native_run_id"], "frame_count": EXPECTED_FRAMES,
            "motion_sha256": motion_hash, "frame_map_sha256": map_hash,
            "native_site_sha256": site_hash,
            "route_readback_sha256": route_readback_hash,
            "camera_sha256": camera_hashes,
            "diagnostic_fixture": index["diagnostic_fixture"],
            "source_integrity_passed": True, "full_video_decode": False,
            "actual_pixels": False, "physical_completion": False,
            "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}


def audit_decoded_media(attempt: Path, case_id: str, *,
                        allow_diagnostic: bool = False) -> dict:
    """Fully decode each sealed original camera stream at 20 Hz for 900 frames.

    This validates file integrity and decodability, not scene content or legal
    visibility. The source-index audit runs first and resolves the exact paths.
    """
    integrity = audit_integrity(attempt, case_id,
                                allow_diagnostic=allow_diagnostic)
    index = _read(Path(attempt) / "capture-index.json")
    decoded = {}
    for camera in CAMERAS:
        path, digest = _sealed(Path(attempt), index["cameras"][camera], camera)
        probe = subprocess.run(
            ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0",
             "-count_frames", "-show_entries",
             "stream=codec_name,width,height,avg_frame_rate,nb_read_frames",
             "-of", "json", str(path)], capture_output=True, text=True,
            timeout=120, check=False)
        if probe.returncode or not probe.stdout:
            raise ValueError(f"{camera} media probe failed")
        try:
            streams = json.loads(probe.stdout)["streams"]
            stream, = streams
            numerator, denominator = map(int, stream["avg_frame_rate"].split("/"))
            valid = (stream["codec_name"] in
                     {"ffv1", "huffyuv", "png", "rawvideo"} and
                     type(stream["width"]) is int and stream["width"] > 0 and
                     type(stream["height"]) is int and stream["height"] > 0 and
                     denominator > 0 and numerator == 20 * denominator and
                     int(stream["nb_read_frames"]) == EXPECTED_FRAMES)
        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError):
            valid = False
        if not valid:
            raise ValueError(f"{camera} media codec, dimensions, rate or frames differ")
        decode = subprocess.run(
            ["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-xerror", "-i", str(path),
             "-map", "0:v:0", "-f", "null", "-"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120, check=False)
        if decode.returncode:
            raise ValueError(f"{camera} full video decode failed")
        decoded[camera] = {"sha256": digest, "frames": EXPECTED_FRAMES,
                           "width": stream["width"],
                           "height": stream["height"],
                           "codec": stream["codec_name"]}
    return {**integrity, "full_video_decode": True,
            "decoded_cameras": decoded,
            "actual_pixels": False, "physical_completion": False}

"""Exact-case Native acquisition, preserving original site, speed and media."""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import json
import hashlib

from capture_finalizer import finalize_capture
from native_media import NativeMedia
from native_motion import capture_speed
from native_site import construct


def capture(world, packet_path: Path, attempt: Path, case_id: str,
            native_run_id: str, uncertainty_mps: float, transform_factory,
            control_factory, *, diagnostic_fixture=False,
            media_factory=NativeMedia):
    """Acquire one 900-tick run; clean up actors and writers on every exit.

    The caller owns world synchronous settings, traffic control and the reviewed
    route packet. This function never treats a diagnostic map as a real site.
    """
    packet = json.loads(Path(packet_path).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    if packet.get('diagnostic_fixture') is not diagnostic_fixture:
        raise ValueError('Native site and capture provenance differ')
    site = construct(world, packet_path, case_id, transform_factory)
    media = None
    try:
        attempt = Path(attempt)
        attempt.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        site_source = attempt / 'native-site-source.json'
        source_bytes = Path(packet_path).read_bytes()
        if hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest() != site.packet_sha256:
            raise ValueError('Native site packet changed after construction')
        with site_source.open('xb') as stream:
            stream.write(source_bytes)
        media = media_factory(site.cameras, attempt,
                              diagnostic_fixture=diagnostic_fixture)
        motion = capture_speed(world, site.actor, control_factory, attempt,
                               case_id, native_run_id, uncertainty_mps,
                               diagnostic_fixture=diagnostic_fixture,
                               camera_frame_reader=media.read,
                               route_reader=site.observe_route)
        frames, paths = media.finish()
        index = finalize_capture(attempt, case_id, frames, paths,
                                 site_source=site_source)
        return {'motion': motion, 'capture_index': index,
                'site_packet_sha256': site.packet_sha256}
    finally:
        if media is not None:
            media.abort()
        site.close()

"""Lazy Native speed acquisition for the three exact boundary probes.

The caller supplies a reviewed route and camera capture. This module only
controls and reads the ego actor; CPU tests use a fake world and actor.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

from speed_capture import write_original_speed
from delivery_audit import CAMERAS

FRAMES = 900
HZ = 20
MPH_PER_MPS = 2.2369362920544
TARGETS = {"below": 75.0, "equal": 80.0, "above": 85.0}
CASE_PREFIX = "testing__C10301__NRS-484B-600-1e__motor_vehicle_driver__"


def _speed(actor) -> float:
    velocity = actor.get_velocity()
    components = (velocity.x, velocity.y, velocity.z)
    if any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value)
           for value in components):
        raise ValueError("invalid original Native velocity")
    return math.sqrt(sum(value * value for value in components))


def _position(actor) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
    location = actor.get_transform().location
    components = (location.x, location.y, location.z)
    if any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value)
           for value in components):
        raise ValueError("invalid original Native position")
    return tuple(float(value) for value in components)


def capture_speed(world, actor, control_factory, attempt: Path, case_id: str,
                  native_run_id: str, uncertainty_mps: float, *,
                  diagnostic_fixture: bool = False,
                  camera_frame_reader=None, route_reader=None) -> dict:
    """Tick at 20 Hz, retain original speeds, and stop the actor on every exit.

    ``uncertainty_mps`` is supplied by the reviewed acquisition plan. It is not
    inferred from a requested speed or a synthetic fixture.
    """
    suffix = case_id.rsplit("__", 1)[-1]
    if suffix not in TARGETS or case_id != CASE_PREFIX + suffix:
        raise ValueError("unknown exact boundary case")
    if (type(uncertainty_mps) not in (int, float) or
            not math.isfinite(uncertainty_mps) or uncertainty_mps < 0):
        raise ValueError("invalid reviewed speed uncertainty")
    if type(diagnostic_fixture) is not bool:
        raise ValueError("invalid diagnostic fixture flag")
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    reserved = ["original-speed.jsonl", "speed-source.json",
                "native-motion-receipt.json"]
    if camera_frame_reader is not None:
        reserved.append("camera-frame-readback.json")
    if route_reader is not None:
        reserved.append("route-frame-readback.json")
    if any((attempt / name).exists() for name in reserved):
        raise ValueError("original Native attempt artifact already exists")
    settings = world.get_settings()
    if not settings.synchronous_mode or abs(settings.fixed_delta_seconds - 1 / HZ) > 1e-9:
        raise ValueError("Native world must tick synchronously at 20 Hz")
    target = TARGETS[suffix] / MPH_PER_MPS
    rows = []
    camera_rows = []
    route_rows = []
    first_elapsed = None
    first_position = None
    previous_frame = None
    try:
        for index in range(FRAMES):
            observed = _speed(actor)
            error = target - observed
            throttle = min(1.0, max(0.0, 0.20 + 0.12 * error)) if error > 0 else 0.0
            brake = min(1.0, max(0.0, -0.12 * error)) if error < 0 else 0.0
            actor.apply_control(control_factory(throttle=throttle, brake=brake))
            frame = world.tick()
            snapshot = world.get_snapshot()
            if (type(frame) is not int or type(snapshot.frame) is not int or
                    frame != snapshot.frame or
                    (previous_frame is not None and frame != previous_frame + 1)):
                raise ValueError("Native frame identity or sequence differs")
            elapsed = snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds
            if type(elapsed) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(elapsed):
                raise ValueError("invalid Native elapsed time")
            if first_elapsed is None:
                first_elapsed = elapsed
                first_position = _position(actor)
            if abs((elapsed - first_elapsed) - index / HZ) > 1e-5:
                raise ValueError("Native 20 Hz clock differs")
            rows.append({"frame": frame, "time_s": index / HZ,
                         "speed_mps": _speed(actor),
                         "speed_uncertainty_mps": float(uncertainty_mps)})
            if route_reader is not None:
                route = route_reader(actor)
                if (not isinstance(route, dict) or
                        route.get('source') != 'original_native_route_readback' or
                        type(route.get('road_id')) is not int or
                        type(route.get('lane_id')) is not int or
                        type(route.get('route_s_m')) not in (int, float) or
                        type(route.get('centerline_offset_m')) not in (int, float) or
                        not math.isfinite(route['route_s_m']) or
                        not math.isfinite(route['centerline_offset_m']) or
                        route['centerline_offset_m'] < 0 or
                        route['centerline_offset_m'] > 2.0):
                    raise ValueError('original Native route readback invalid')
                route_rows.append({'frame': frame, **route})
            if camera_frame_reader is not None:
                camera_frames = camera_frame_reader(frame)
                if (not isinstance(camera_frames, dict) or
                        camera_frames != {camera: frame for camera in CAMERAS}):
                    raise ValueError("original four-camera frame readback differs")
                camera_rows.append({"frame": frame,
                                    "camera_frames": camera_frames})
            previous_frame = frame
        travel_m = math.dist(first_position, _position(actor))
        if travel_m < 100:
            raise ValueError("Native ego did not travel the reviewed route")
        descriptor = write_original_speed(attempt, case_id, native_run_id, rows,
                                          diagnostic_fixture=diagnostic_fixture)
        camera_hash = None
        if camera_frame_reader is not None:
            camera_bytes = (json.dumps({"case_id": case_id,
                                         "native_run_id": native_run_id,
                                         "frames": camera_rows},
                                        sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode()
            camera_path = attempt / "camera-frame-readback.json"
            camera_path.write_bytes(camera_bytes)
            camera_hash = hashlib.sha256(camera_bytes).hexdigest()
        route_hash = None
        if route_reader is not None:
            route_bytes = (json.dumps({'case_id': case_id,
                                       'native_run_id': native_run_id,
                                       'frames': route_rows},
                                      sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) + '\n').encode()
            (attempt / 'route-frame-readback.json').write_bytes(route_bytes)
            route_hash = hashlib.sha256(route_bytes).hexdigest()
        receipt = {"format": "c10301-native-motion-v1", "case_id": case_id,
                   "native_run_id": native_run_id, "sample_count": FRAMES,
                   "travel_m": travel_m, "speed_source_sha256": descriptor["sha256"],
                   "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic_fixture,
                   "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}
        if camera_hash is not None:
            receipt["camera_frame_readback_sha256"] = camera_hash
        if route_hash is not None:
            receipt['route_frame_readback_sha256'] = route_hash
        (attempt / "native-motion-receipt.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        return receipt
    finally:
        actor.apply_control(control_factory(throttle=0.0, brake=1.0))

"""Source-gated Native actor and camera construction for C10301 speed probes.

The caller supplies an original site packet and CARLA transform factory. This
module does not certify that the source packet describes a lawful public way.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from delivery_audit import CAMERAS
from native_motion import CASE_PREFIX
from native_media import PROFILE

MIN_ROUTE_M = 1800.0
SENSOR_ID = 'sensor.camera.rgb'


class NativeSite:
    def __init__(self, actor, cameras, packet_sha256, native_map, route, road_lane):
        self.actor = actor
        self.cameras = cameras
        self.packet_sha256 = packet_sha256
        self.native_map = native_map
        self.route = route
        self.road_lane = road_lane
        self.previous_route_s_m = None

    def observe_route(self, actor):
        """Read the loaded-map lane and nearest reviewed route station."""
        position = actor.get_transform().location
        if any(not _finite(v) for v in (position.x, position.y, position.z)):
            raise ValueError('nonfinite original Native route position')
        waypoint = self.native_map.get_waypoint(position)
        if waypoint is None or (waypoint.road_id, waypoint.lane_id) != self.road_lane:
            raise ValueError('original Native ego left reviewed route lane')
        projected = []
        for first, second in zip(self.route, self.route[1:]):
            dx, dy = second['x_m'] - first['x_m'], second['y_m'] - first['y_m']
            length_sq = dx * dx + dy * dy
            if length_sq <= 0:
                continue
            fraction = max(0.0, min(1.0, ((position.x - first['x_m']) * dx +
                                            (position.y - first['y_m']) * dy) / length_sq))
            px, py = first['x_m'] + fraction * dx, first['y_m'] + fraction * dy
            projected.append((math.hypot(position.x - px, position.y - py),
                              first['s_m'] + fraction * (second['s_m'] - first['s_m'])))
        if not projected:
            raise ValueError('original reviewed route has no usable segment')
        offset, station = min(projected)
        if offset > 2.0:
            raise ValueError('original Native ego left reviewed route centerline')
        if self.previous_route_s_m is not None and station < self.previous_route_s_m:
            raise ValueError('original Native ego reversed on reviewed route')
        self.previous_route_s_m = station
        return {'road_id': waypoint.road_id, 'lane_id': waypoint.lane_id,
                'route_s_m': station, 'centerline_offset_m': offset,
                'source': 'original_native_route_readback'}

    def close(self):
        for spawned in reversed([self.actor, *self.cameras.values()]):
            spawned.destroy()


def _finite(value):
    return type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value)


def construct(world, packet_path, case_id, transform_factory):
    """Spawn source-bound ego and four cameras, cleaning up failed spawns."""
    if case_id not in {CASE_PREFIX + suffix for suffix in ('below', 'equal', 'above')}:
        raise ValueError('unknown exact speed case')
    packet_path = Path(packet_path)
    raw = packet_path.read_bytes()
    packet = json.loads(raw)
    if (packet.get('format') != 'c10301-native-site-v1' or
            packet.get('case_id') != case_id or
            packet.get('cell_id') != 'C10301' or
            packet.get('layout') != 'alley' or
            packet.get('control') != 'access_aisle' or
            packet.get('actor') != 'motor_vehicle_driver' or
            packet.get('maneuver') != 'travel' or
            type(packet.get('diagnostic_fixture')) is not bool or
            not packet.get('access_aisle_source_ref') or
            not packet.get('route_source_ref')):
        raise ValueError('exact site identity or provenance missing')
    original_map = world.get_map()
    if (not packet.get('map_name') or packet['map_name'] != original_map.name or
            hashlib.sha256(original_map.to_opendrive().encode()).hexdigest() !=
            packet.get('opendrive_sha256')):
        raise ValueError('loaded Native map source differs')
    route = packet.get('route')
    if not isinstance(route, list) or len(route) < 2:
        raise ValueError('original route missing')
    prior_s = None
    road_lane = None
    for point in route:
        if (not isinstance(point, dict) or
                any(not _finite(point.get(key)) for key in ('s_m', 'x_m', 'y_m', 'z_m'))):
            raise ValueError('original route coordinates invalid')
        if prior_s is not None and not 0 < point['s_m'] - prior_s <= 10:
            raise ValueError('original route has a gap or reversal')
        prior_s = point['s_m']
        waypoint = original_map.get_waypoint(transform_factory(point).location)
        if waypoint is None:
            raise ValueError('original route has no loaded-map waypoint')
        location = waypoint.transform.location
        if (any(not _finite(value) for value in (location.x, location.y, location.z)) or
                math.dist((point['x_m'], point['y_m'], point['z_m']),
                          (location.x, location.y, location.z)) > 2.0):
            raise ValueError('original route leaves loaded-map centerline')
        lane = (waypoint.road_id, waypoint.lane_id)
        if road_lane is None:
            road_lane = lane
        if lane != road_lane:
            raise ValueError('original route leaves reviewed lane')
    if route[-1]['s_m'] - route[0]['s_m'] < MIN_ROUTE_M:
        raise ValueError('original route too short for 45-second speed probe')
    vehicle_id = packet.get('vehicle_blueprint_id')
    camera_plan = packet.get('cameras')
    if (not isinstance(vehicle_id, str) or not vehicle_id.startswith('vehicle.') or
            not isinstance(camera_plan, dict) or set(camera_plan) != set(CAMERAS)):
        raise ValueError('vehicle or four-camera construction plan missing')
    library = world.get_blueprint_library()
    spawned = []
    try:
        actor = world.spawn_actor(library.find(vehicle_id),
                                  transform_factory(route[0]))
        if actor is None:
            raise ValueError('Native vehicle spawn failed')
        spawned.append(actor)
        cameras = {}
        for camera in CAMERAS:
            spec = camera_plan[camera]
            if (not isinstance(spec, dict) or spec.get('blueprint_id') != SENSOR_ID or
                    not all(_finite(spec.get(key)) for key in
                            ('x_m', 'y_m', 'z_m', 'pitch_deg', 'yaw_deg', 'roll_deg')) or
                    spec['z_m'] <= 0):
                raise ValueError('original camera construction spec invalid')
            blueprint = library.find(SENSOR_ID)
            if not hasattr(blueprint, 'set_attribute'):
                raise ValueError('Native camera blueprint lacks attribute control')
            width, height = PROFILE[camera]
            blueprint.set_attribute('image_size_x', str(width))
            blueprint.set_attribute('image_size_y', str(height))
            blueprint.set_attribute('sensor_tick', '0.05')
            sensor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint,
                                       transform_factory(spec), attach_to=actor)
            if sensor is None:
                raise ValueError('Native camera spawn failed')
            spawned.append(sensor)
            cameras[camera] = sensor
        return NativeSite(actor, cameras, hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                          original_map, route, road_lane)
    except Exception:
        for item in reversed(spawned):
            item.destroy()
        raise

"""Operator-owned world lifecycle for one exact C10301 Native speed attempt.

The caller supplies an existing CARLA client and reviewed site packet. This
wrapper never allocates a server and restores map, settings and weather even
when construction, capture or saved finalization fails.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy

from native_capture import capture


def capture_owned(client, packet_path, attempt, case_id, native_run_id,
                  uncertainty_mps, transform_factory, control_factory, *,
                  diagnostic_fixture=False, media_factory=None):
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot, restore

    saved = snapshot(client)
    try:
        world = client.get_world()
        settings = copy.copy(world.get_settings())
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 0.05
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        current = world.get_settings()
        if (current.synchronous_mode is not True or
                abs(current.fixed_delta_seconds - 0.05) > 1e-9):
            raise ValueError('Native world 20 Hz settings readback differs')
        kwargs = {'diagnostic_fixture': diagnostic_fixture}
        if media_factory is not None:
            kwargs['media_factory'] = media_factory
        return capture(world, packet_path, attempt, case_id, native_run_id,
                       uncertainty_mps, transform_factory, control_factory, **kwargs)
    finally:
        restore(client, saved)

"""Saved-only speed source join; no CARLA import or physical acceptance claim."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from speed_boundary import measure
from delivery_audit import audit_decoded_media


def process(attempt: Path, case_id: str, output: Path, *,
            allow_diagnostic: bool = False) -> dict:
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    receipt_path = attempt / "native-motion-receipt.json"
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if (receipt.get("format") != "c10301-native-motion-v1" or
            receipt.get("case_id") != case_id or
            receipt.get("sample_count") != 900 or
            type(receipt.get("travel_m")) not in (int, float) or
            not math.isfinite(receipt["travel_m"]) or
            receipt["travel_m"] < 100 or
            receipt.get("physical_acceptance_claimed") is not False or
            type(receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture")) is not bool):
        raise ValueError("Native motion source receipt incomplete")
    if receipt["diagnostic_fixture"] and not allow_diagnostic:
        raise ValueError("diagnostic fixture cannot enter delivery processing")
    observation = measure(attempt, case_id)
    if (observation["source_sha256"] != receipt.get("speed_source_sha256") or
            observation["native_run_id"] != receipt.get("native_run_id") or
            observation["diagnostic_fixture"] != receipt["diagnostic_fixture"]):
        raise ValueError("saved speed source and motion receipt differ")
    result = {"format": "c10301-saved-speed-v1", "case_id": case_id,
              "native_run_id": receipt["native_run_id"],
              "native_motion_receipt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(receipt_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "measurement": observation, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
              "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}
    output = Path(output)
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("saved speed output already exists")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
                      encoding="utf-8")
    return result


def process_delivery(attempt: Path, case_id: str, output: Path, *,
                     allow_diagnostic: bool = False) -> dict:
    """Saved-only speed and fully decoded media, written after all checks pass."""
    output = Path(output)
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("saved delivery output already exists")
    media = audit_decoded_media(attempt, case_id,
                                allow_diagnostic=allow_diagnostic)
    speed = measure(attempt, case_id)
    if (media["native_run_id"] != speed["native_run_id"] or
            media["case_id"] != speed["case_id"]):
        raise ValueError("saved speed and media run identity differ")
    result = {"format": "c10301-saved-delivery-v1",
              "case_id": case_id, "native_run_id": speed["native_run_id"],
              "measurement": speed, "media_audit": media,
              "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
              "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
                      encoding="utf-8")
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--case-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--allow-diagnostic", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(process_delivery(args.attempt, args.case_id, args.output,
                                      allow_diagnostic=args.allow_diagnostic), indent=2))

"""Source-bound 80 mph speed observations and controlled comparison.

These are engineering observations, not statutory verdicts. A sampled maximum
cannot rule out a peak between samples. Diagnostic fixtures never prove motion.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

MPH_PER_MPS = 2.2369362920544
BOUNDARY_MPH = 80.0
EXPECTED_FRAMES = 900
EXPECTED_HZ = 20.0
PROBE_WINDOW_FRAMES = 20


def _read_json(path: Path) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid source document: {path.name}")
    return value


def _number(value: object, name: str) -> float:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid {name}")
    return float(value)


def measure(attempt: Path, case_id: str) -> dict:
    """Read all original speed samples and a hash-bound Native source descriptor."""
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    descriptor = _read_json(attempt / "speed-source.json")
    if (descriptor.get("format") != "c10301-original-speed-source-v1" or
            descriptor.get("case_id") != case_id or
            descriptor.get("source") != "original-speed.jsonl" or
            descriptor.get("sample_rate_hz") != EXPECTED_HZ or
            descriptor.get("sample_count") != EXPECTED_FRAMES or
            not isinstance(descriptor.get("native_run_id"), str) or
            not descriptor["native_run_id"] or
            not isinstance(descriptor.get("source_frame_origin"), int) or
            descriptor["source_frame_origin"] < 0):
        raise ValueError("original speed descriptor incomplete or wrong case")
    raw = (attempt / "original-speed.jsonl").read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    if descriptor.get("sha256") != digest:
        raise ValueError("original speed source hash differs")
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if len(rows) != EXPECTED_FRAMES:
        raise ValueError("original speed frame count differs")
    origin = descriptor["source_frame_origin"]
    speed_mph = []
    uncertainties_mph = []
    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        if not isinstance(row, dict) or row.get("frame") != origin + index:
            raise ValueError("original speed frame sequence differs")
        time_s = _number(row.get("time_s"), "original time")
        if abs(time_s - index / EXPECTED_HZ) > 1e-6:
            raise ValueError("original speed sample time differs")
        value = _number(row.get("speed_mps"), "original speed")
        uncertainty = _number(row.get("speed_uncertainty_mps"), "speed uncertainty")
        if value < 0 or uncertainty < 0:
            raise ValueError("negative speed or uncertainty")
        speed_mph.append(value * MPH_PER_MPS)
        uncertainties_mph.append(uncertainty * MPH_PER_MPS)
    peak_index = max(range(EXPECTED_FRAMES), key=speed_mph.__getitem__)
    peak = speed_mph[peak_index]
    peak_uncertainty = uncertainties_mph[peak_index]
    min_lower = min(value - uncertainty for value, uncertainty in zip(speed_mph, uncertainties_mph))
    max_upper = max(value + uncertainty for value, uncertainty in zip(speed_mph, uncertainties_mph))
    if min_lower > BOUNDARY_MPH:
        sampled_relation = "all_samples_above"
    elif max_upper < BOUNDARY_MPH:
        sampled_relation = "all_samples_below"
    elif any(value - uncertainty > BOUNDARY_MPH for value, uncertainty in zip(speed_mph, uncertainties_mph)):
        sampled_relation = "some_sample_clearly_above"
    else:
        sampled_relation = "boundary_unresolved"
    # A full second of consecutive original samples is more informative than
    # one peak sample. Keep the relation observational: no intersample claim.
    sample_classes = []
    for value, uncertainty in zip(speed_mph, uncertainties_mph):
        if value + uncertainty < BOUNDARY_MPH:
            sample_classes.append("below")
        elif value - uncertainty > BOUNDARY_MPH:
            sample_classes.append("above")
        else:
            sample_classes.append("boundary_interval")
    suffix = case_id.rsplit("__", 1)[-1]
    expected_class = {"below": "below", "equal": "boundary_interval",
                      "above": "above"}.get(suffix)
    if expected_class is None:
        raise ValueError("unknown exact speed probe case")
    witness_start = next((start for start in range(20, EXPECTED_FRAMES - PROBE_WINDOW_FRAMES + 1)
                          if all(item == expected_class for item in
                                 sample_classes[start:start + PROBE_WINDOW_FRAMES])), None)
    probe = {"expected_sample_class": expected_class,
             "window_frames": PROBE_WINDOW_FRAMES,
             "post_startup_window_found": witness_start is not None,
             "first_window_frame": None if witness_start is None else origin + witness_start,
             "sample_class_counts": {kind: sample_classes.count(kind) for kind in
                                     ("below", "boundary_interval", "above")},
             "interpretation": "sampled_only"}
    return {
        "format": "c10301-speed-measurement-v1", "case_id": case_id,
        "native_run_id": descriptor["native_run_id"], "source": "original-speed.jsonl",
        "source_sha256": digest, "sample_count": EXPECTED_FRAMES,
        "sample_rate_hz": EXPECTED_HZ, "peak_sample_frame": origin + peak_index,
        "peak_sample_mph": peak, "peak_uncertainty_mph": peak_uncertainty,
        "sampled_relation": sampled_relation,
        "case_probe": probe,
        "between_sample_peaks": "unobserved", "diagnostic_fixture": descriptor.get("diagnostic_fixture") is True,
        "physical_acceptance_claimed": False, "legal_judgment": "unresolved",
    }


def compare(plan_path: Path, attempts: dict[str, Path]) -> dict:
    """Check source identities, fixed settings and observed ordering for one triple."""
    plan_bytes = Path(plan_path).read_bytes()
    plan = json.loads(plan_bytes)
    comparison = next((item for item in plan.get("comparisons", [])
                       if item.get("comparison_id") == "strict_rate_boundary"), None)
    if comparison is None or len(comparison.get("case_ids", [])) != 3:
        raise ValueError("strict rate comparison needs three exact cases")
    case_ids = comparison["case_ids"]
    assignment = "testing__C10301__NRS-484B-600-1e__motor_vehicle_driver"
    if case_ids != [assignment + "__" + suffix
                    for suffix in ("below", "equal", "above")]:
        raise ValueError("strict rate comparison case order differs")
    if set(attempts) != set(case_ids) or len({Path(p).resolve() for p in attempts.values()}) != 3:
        raise ValueError("three distinct exact case attempts required")
    setups = []
    measurements = []
    original_sites = []
    site_hashes = []
    for case_id in case_ids:
        attempt = Path(attempts[case_id])
        setup = _read_json(attempt / "authored-setup.json")
        if setup.get("case_id") != case_id or setup.get("law_id") != "NRS-484B-600-1e":
            raise ValueError("authored setup identity differs")
        for key, expected in {"cell_id": "C10301",
                              "actor": "motor_vehicle_driver",
                              "layout": "alley", "control": "access_aisle",
                              "maneuver": "travel"}.items():
            if setup.get(key) != expected:
                raise ValueError("authored setup cell or actor differs")
        target = _number(setup.get("requested_speed_mph"), "requested speed")
        if target < 0:
            raise ValueError("negative requested speed")
        setups.append(setup)
        measurement = measure(attempt, case_id)
        measurements.append(measurement)
        capture_index = attempt / 'capture-index.json'
        if capture_index.exists():
            index = _read_json(capture_index)
            binding = index.get('native_site')
            if (index.get('case_id') != case_id or
                    not isinstance(binding, dict) or
                    set(binding) != {'path', 'sha256'} or
                    not isinstance(binding['path'], str) or
                    Path(binding['path']).is_absolute() or
                    '..' in Path(binding['path']).parts):
                raise ValueError('original Native site comparison binding missing')
            site_path = attempt / binding['path']
            if (not site_path.is_file() or site_path.is_symlink() or
                    not site_path.resolve().is_relative_to(attempt.resolve())):
                raise ValueError('original Native site comparison source missing')
            site_raw = site_path.read_bytes()
            site_hash = hashlib.sha256(site_raw).hexdigest()
            if site_hash != binding['sha256']:
                raise ValueError('original Native site comparison hash differs')
            site = json.loads(site_raw)
            if (site.get('case_id') != case_id or
                    site.get('format') != 'c10301-native-site-v1' or
                    site.get('diagnostic_fixture') != measurement['diagnostic_fixture']):
                raise ValueError('original Native site comparison identity differs')
            original_sites.append({key: value for key, value in site.items()
                                   if key != 'case_id'})
            site_hashes.append(site_hash)
        elif not measurement['diagnostic_fixture']:
            raise ValueError('original Native site comparison source required')
    fixed = set(setups[0]) - {"case_id", "requested_speed_mph"}
    if any(set(item) != set(setups[0]) or any(item[key] != setups[0][key] for key in fixed)
           for item in setups[1:]):
        raise ValueError("fixed authored setup differs")
    targets = [item["requested_speed_mph"] for item in setups]
    if not (targets[0] < BOUNDARY_MPH and targets[1] == BOUNDARY_MPH and
            targets[2] > BOUNDARY_MPH):
        raise ValueError("requested boundary probes differ")
    observed = [item["peak_sample_mph"] for item in measurements]
    if not observed[0] < observed[1] < observed[2]:
        raise ValueError("original sampled speed ordering differs")
    if len({item["native_run_id"] for item in measurements}) != 3:
        raise ValueError("comparison reuses an original Native run")
    if original_sites and (len(original_sites) != 3 or
                           any(site != original_sites[0] for site in original_sites[1:])):
        raise ValueError('fixed original Native site differs')
    return {
        "format": "c10301-speed-comparison-v1", "comparison_id": "strict_rate_boundary",
        "case_ids": case_ids, "plan_sha256": hashlib.sha256(plan_bytes).hexdigest(),
        "source_sha256": [item["source_sha256"] for item in measurements],
        "native_site_sha256": site_hashes,
        "fixed_original_site_passed": len(original_sites) == 3,
        "requested_speed_mph": targets, "peak_sample_mph": observed,
        "sampled_relations": [item["sampled_relation"] for item in measurements],
        "fixed_setup_passed": True, "observed_order_passed": True,
        "diagnostic_fixture": any(item["diagnostic_fixture"] for item in measurements),
        "physical_acceptance_claimed": False, "legal_judgment": "unresolved",
    }

"""Write a Native-speed source once from observed frame samples.

Call this from the eventual CARLA runner after retaining the original frame map.
It does not choose targets, invent observations, or connect to CARLA on import.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from speed_boundary import EXPECTED_FRAMES, EXPECTED_HZ


def write_original_speed(attempt: Path, case_id: str, native_run_id: str,
                         samples: list[dict], *, diagnostic_fixture: bool = False) -> dict:
    if not case_id or not native_run_id or type(diagnostic_fixture) is not bool:
        raise ValueError("missing original speed identity")
    if len(samples) != EXPECTED_FRAMES:
        raise ValueError("original speed needs 900 frames")
    origin = samples[0].get("frame")
    if not isinstance(origin, int) or isinstance(origin, bool) or origin < 0:
        raise ValueError("invalid original frame origin")
    rows = []
    for index, sample in enumerate(samples):
        if set(sample) != {"frame", "time_s", "speed_mps", "speed_uncertainty_mps"}:
            raise ValueError("original speed sample fields differ")
        if sample["frame"] != origin + index:
            raise ValueError("original speed frame sequence differs")
        for name in ("time_s", "speed_mps", "speed_uncertainty_mps"):
            value = sample[name]
            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (float, int)) or not math.isfinite(value):
                raise ValueError("invalid original " + name)
        if abs(sample["time_s"] - index / EXPECTED_HZ) > 1e-6:
            raise ValueError("original speed sample time differs")
        if sample["speed_mps"] < 0 or sample["speed_uncertainty_mps"] < 0:
            raise ValueError("negative original speed or uncertainty")
        rows.append(sample)
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    attempt.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    source = attempt / "original-speed.jsonl"
    descriptor_path = attempt / "speed-source.json"
    if source.exists() or descriptor_path.exists():
        raise ValueError("original speed source already exists")
    raw = "".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in rows).encode()
    descriptor = {
        "format": "c10301-original-speed-source-v1", "case_id": case_id,
        "source": source.name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        "sample_rate_hz": EXPECTED_HZ, "sample_count": EXPECTED_FRAMES,
        "source_frame_origin": origin, "native_run_id": native_run_id,
        "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic_fixture,
    }
    source.write_bytes(raw)
    descriptor_path.write_text(json.dumps(descriptor, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return descriptor

"""Exact speed-case preflight and source-gated Native runner."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


def check():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    config = json.loads((root / "config.json").read_text())
    source = (root / "case-plan.json").read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest() != config["plan_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Exact source plan changed")
    plan = json.loads(source)
    if plan["assignment_id"] != config["assignment_id"] or plan["law_id"] != config["law_id"]:
        raise ValueError("Assignment identity changed")
    matches = [row for row in plan["cases"] if row["case_id"] == config["selected_case_id"]]
    if len(matches) != 1 or matches[0]["intended_speed_mph"] != config["requested_speed_mph"]:
        raise ValueError("Exact speed case changed")
    if (config["rate_hz"], config["frame_count"], config["duration_s"]) != (20, 900, 45):
        raise ValueError("Original observation clock changed")
    if config["cameras"] != ["overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference"]:
        raise ValueError("Original camera profile changed")
    if config["required_sources"] != ["reviewed_site_packet", "original_motion", "route_readback", "four_camera_media"]:
        raise ValueError("Original source requirements changed")
    return config


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--site-packet")
    parser.add_argument("--native-run-id")
    parser.add_argument("--uncertainty-mps", type=float)
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="localhost")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = check()
    if args.check:
        print("exact diagnostic speed bundle passed: " + config["selected_case_id"])
        return
    if not all((args.output_dir, args.site_packet, args.native_run_id)) or args.uncertainty_mps is None:
        raise ValueError("Reviewed C10301 route, access-aisle authority and Native site packet required")
    packet_path = Path(args.site_packet)
    packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if packet.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not False or packet.get("case_id") != config["selected_case_id"]:
        raise ValueError("Reviewed C10301 Native site packet provenance or case differs")
    if not packet.get("route_source_ref") or not packet.get("access_aisle_source_ref"):
        raise ValueError("Reviewed C10301 route and access-aisle sources required")
    attempt = Path(args.output_dir)
    if attempt.exists() and any(attempt.iterdir()):
        raise ValueError("Native attempt output already exists")
    import carla
    from owned_capture import capture_owned

    def transform(spec):
        return carla.Transform(
            carla.Location(x=spec["x_m"], y=spec["y_m"], z=spec["z_m"]),
            carla.Rotation(pitch=spec.get("pitch_deg", 0.0),
                           yaw=spec.get("yaw_deg", 0.0),
                           roll=spec.get("roll_deg", 0.0)))

    def control(*, throttle, brake):
        return carla.VehicleControl(throttle=throttle, brake=brake)

    client = carla.Client(args.host, args.port)
    client.set_timeout(30.0)
    capture_owned(client, packet_path, attempt, config["selected_case_id"],
                  args.native_run_id, args.uncertainty_mps, transform, control)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import types
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
import runner


class BundleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_source_and_clock(self):
        config = runner.check()
        self.assertEqual(config["frame_count"], 900)
        self.assertEqual(config["selected_case_id"], json.loads((Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "config.json").read_text())["selected_case_id"])

    def test_unreviewed_native_run_rejected(self):
        with patch("sys.argv", ["runner.py", "--output-dir", "."]):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Reviewed C10301 route"):
                runner.main()

    def test_source_gated_live_capture_binding(self):
        config = runner.check()
        carla = types.SimpleNamespace(
            Client=MagicMock(), Location=MagicMock(), Rotation=MagicMock(),
            Transform=MagicMock(), VehicleControl=MagicMock())
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            packet = Path(directory) / "reviewed-site.json"
            packet.write_text(json.dumps({
                "case_id": config["selected_case_id"],
                "diagnostic_fixture": False,
                "route_source_ref": "reviewed-route-source",
                "access_aisle_source_ref": "reviewed-aisle-source"}) + "\n")
            args = ["runner.py", "--output-dir", str(Path(directory) / "attempt"),
                    "--site-packet", str(packet), "--native-run-id", "original-1",
                    "--uncertainty-mps", "0.1"]
            with patch.dict(sys.modules, {"carla": carla}), \
                    patch("owned_capture.capture_owned") as capture, \
                    patch("sys.argv", args):
                runner.main()
            capture.assert_called_once()
            self.assertEqual(capture.call_args.args[3], config["selected_case_id"])
            self.assertEqual(capture.call_args.args[4], "original-1")
            self.assertFalse(capture.call_args.kwargs)
            packet.write_text(json.dumps({
                "case_id": "wrong", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
                "route_source_ref": "reviewed-route-source",
                "access_aisle_source_ref": "reviewed-aisle-source"}) + "\n")
            with patch.dict(sys.modules, {"carla": carla}), \
                    patch("owned_capture.capture_owned") as capture, \
                    patch("sys.argv", args):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "provenance or case differs"):
                    runner.main()
            capture.assert_not_called()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
